description: “As the Deacon of St Raphael Church in Springfield, Ohio, I have known Tracey Tackett for over 35 years. Tracey integrates her care for her community into everything she does. As a dedicated and proud citizen, Tracey displays a unique awareness of the world around her that is good for her community
title: Endorsement: Deacon Norman G. Horstman — Tracey Tackett for Congress
